grammar_points.title: 很 as degree adverb
grammar_points.explanation: Used to describe the degree of an adjective. 很 means 'very' but is often used as a linker between subject and adjective.
examples: 我很好。Wǒ hěn hǎo. (I'm very good.)
她很好。Tā hěn hǎo. (She is very good.)

grammar_points.title: Question particle 呢
grammar_points.explanation: Used to ask 'and you?' or 'how about...?' after a statement. It bounces the question back to the other person.
examples: 我很好，你呢？Wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne? (I'm fine, and you?)

grammar_points.title: Negation with 不
grammar_points.explanation: Place 不 before a verb or adjective to negate it. Note tone sandhi: 不 (bù) changes to bú before a 4th tone syllable.
examples: 不好。Bù hǎo. (Not good.)
不客气。Bú kèqi. (You're welcome.)
不谢。Bú xiè. (Don't mention it.)

grammar_points.title: Copula 是
grammar_points.explanation: 是 connects a subject to a noun predicate, equivalent to 'am/is/are' in English.
examples: 我是学生。Wǒ shì xuésheng. (I am a student.)
他是中国人。Tā shì Zhōngguó rén. (He is Chinese.)

grammar_points.title: 也 (also/too)
grammar_points.explanation: 也 is placed before the verb to mean 'also' or 'too'.
examples: 我也是学生。Wǒ yě shì xuésheng. (I am also a student.)

grammar_points.title: 有 (to have)
grammar_points.explanation: 有 expresses possession or existence. For negation, use 没有 (méiyǒu).
examples: 我有中国朋友。Wǒ yǒu Zhōngguó péngyou. (I have Chinese friends.)
我家有五口人。Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. (My family has five people.)

grammar_points.title: 几 questions (how many)
grammar_points.explanation: 几 asks about small quantities (typically under 10). The measure word must be included.
examples: 你家有几口人？Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén? (How many people are in your family?)
你女儿几岁了？Nǐ nǚ'ér jǐ suì le? (How old is your daughter?)

grammar_points.title: 多 questions (how)
grammar_points.explanation: 多 asks 'how' before adjectives like 大 (old) and 高 (tall).
examples: 你多大了？Nǐ duō dà le? (How old are you?)

grammar_points.title: 会 (can/be able to)
grammar_points.explanation: 会 expresses learned skills or abilities (as opposed to 能 which expresses physical ability or permission).
examples: 我会说汉语。Wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ. (I can speak Chinese.)
你会写汉字吗？Nǐ huì xiě Hànzì ma? (Can you write Chinese characters?)

grammar_points.title: 怎么 (how)
grammar_points.explanation: 怎么 asks how something is done or how to do something.
examples: 这个字怎么念？Zhège zì zěnme niàn? (How do you pronounce this character?)

grammar_points.pattern: 今天/昨天/明天 + 月 + 号/日
grammar_points.title: Date expressions
grammar_points.explanation: Chinese dates follow the pattern: time-word + month + date-number. 号 (hào) or 日 (rì) can be used for the day.
examples: 今天是九月十五号。Jīntiān shì jiǔ yuè shíwǔ hào. (Today is September 15th.)
明天是星期一。Míngtiān shì xīngqī yī. (Tomorrow is Monday.)

grammar_points.title: 去 (to go)
grammar_points.explanation: 去 expresses going to a place. The destination follows 去 directly.
examples: 你去哪儿？Nǐ qù nǎr? (Where are you going?)
我去学校。Wǒ qù xuéxiào. (I'm going to school.)

grammar_points.title: 想 (to want/to think)
grammar_points.explanation: 想 expresses desire or intention to do something. It's softer than 要 (yào).
examples: 我想喝茶。Wǒ xiǎng hē chá. (I want to drink tea.)
我想买杯子。Wǒ xiǎng mǎi bēizi. (I want to buy a cup.)

grammar_points.title: Demonstratives 这/那
grammar_points.explanation: 这 (zhè) = this, 那 (nà) = that. A measure word must be used between the demonstrative and the noun.
examples: 这个杯子多少钱？Zhège bēizi duōshao qián? (How much is this cup?)
那个杯子十八块。Nàge bēizi shíbā kuài. (That cup is 18 yuan.)

grammar_points.title: 在 (at/in/on) location
grammar_points.explanation: 在 indicates location where an action takes place. It can also be used with position words like 上面 (above), 下面 (below), 里面 (inside).
examples: 你儿子在哪儿工作？Nǐ érzi zài nǎr gōngzuò? (Where does your son work?)
猫在椅子下面。Māo zài yǐzi xiàmiàn. (The cat is under the chair.)
